Recording that receipt writes `.clarity/coverage.json`, which `sovkernel.scope` reports as outside every prefix the grant admits. The two differ in both directions: a staged file the commit does not hold is counted, and an unstaged new file the working tree holds is not. That is a check whose population is not the artifact a pre-commit run is grading, and it is what made my earlier reading diverge. Pre-existing; not introduced by this candidate; recorded rather than attributed to it.
